children.name: Aptostichus barackobamai
children.description: Aptostichus barackobamai (also known as the Barack Obama trapdoor spider) is a large species of trapdoor spider in the family Euctenizidae named after the 44th President of the United States, Barack Obama.

children.name: Aptostichus atomarius
children.description: Aptostichus atomarius, the San Bernardino hills trapdoor spider, is a species of wafer-lid trapdoor spider in the family Euctenizidae.

children.name: Aptostichus stephencolberti
children.description: Aptostichus stephencolberti is a species of spider in the family Euctenizidae, named after the American satirist Stephen Colbert.

children.name: Aptostichus bonoi
children.description: Aptostichus bonoi, or Bono's Joshua Tree trapdoor spider, is a morphological species of Euctenizidae spiders, nocturnal arthropods who seize their prey after leaping out of their burrows and inject it with venom.

children.name: Aptostichus stanfordianus
children.description: Aptostichus stanfordianus, the Stanford Hills trapdoor spider, is a species of wafer-lid trapdoor spider (Euctenizidae) endemic to California in the United States.

children.name: Aptostichus miwok
children.description: Aptostichus miwok is a species of spiders in the family Euctenizidae named after the Coast Miwok Indian tribe known to have inhabited the coastal areas of California from the Golden Gate northward prior to European settlement.

children.name: Promyrmekiaphila clathrata
children.description: Promyrmekiaphila clathrata is a species of wafer-lid trapdoor spider in the family Euctenizidae that is endemic to the state of California in the United States.

children.name: Eucteniza relata
children.description: Eucteniza relata, the southwestern trapdoor spider, is a species of wafer-lid trapdoor spider in the family Euctenizidae.
